description: Verifies the Novikov-Thorne thin disk: the ISCO radius for Schwarzschild, prograde and retrograde Kerr holes, the closed-form Page-Thorne function against numerical quadrature, the radiative efficiency, the normalization of the circular four-velocity, and the flux and temperature profile.

checks.label: the prograde ISCO of a = 0.998 lies between 1 and 1.3 r_g
the retrograde ISCO of a = -0.9 lies between 8 and 9.5 r_g
the Page-Thorne function vanishes at the ISCO for every sampled spin
the closed form agrees with numerical quadrature within a relative 1e-7
the efficiency of a = 0.998 lies between 0.30 and 0.35
the circular four-velocity satisfies u.u = -1 across the disk
the flux and temperature vanish inside the ISCO
the flux and temperature are positive outside the ISCO
the flux peaks between one and three ISCO radii
